understanding.goal_understanding: The goal is to clear each level by completing all goal cells. A goal cell is completed by stepping onto it only when the carried piece’s shape, color, and rotation exactly match that goal’s required shape/color/rotation; once all goals in a level are completed you advance to the next level, and winning all levels completes the game.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each move (north/south/east/west) costs 1 stamina; when stamina reaches 0 you lose 1 life and stamina resets to its maximum, and losing all lives ends the game (GAME_OVER). Walls block movement, and each turn the state provides a list of blocked_directions that must never be chosen. Stepping on modifier tiles changes the carried piece: shape tiles cycle shape IDs 0–5 (wrapping), color tiles cycle colors in order orange → blue → green → red → orange, and rotation tiles rotate 90° clockwise (0° → 90° → 180° → 270° → 0°). Goals only activate (become completable) when shape, color, and rotation all match simultaneously; otherwise you must route through the appropriate modifier tiles (and optionally stamina refills) to adjust attributes before stepping onto the goal.
